request.query: query($owner: String!, $name: String!, $e0: String!, $e1: String!, $e2: String!,

f2.text:
# Lint: npx @redocly/cli lint contracts/openapi.yaml
extends: [minimal]
rules:
  struct: error
  no-unresolved-refs: error
  no-invalid-schema-examples: error
  no-invalid-media-type-examples: error
  operation-summary: off
  tag-description: off
  info-license: off
  no-server-example.com: off

f3.text:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: CareerLens API
  version: 0.2.0
  description: |
    Contract between apps/api (Claude Code) and apps/web + apps/extension (Codex).
    SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Changes only via a Contract Change Request (template in docs/HANDOFF.md),
    approved by a human, then regenerate packages/api-client.
    Auth: Bearer (Supabase JWT). With DEV_AUTH=1 the server accepts any request and uses the demo profile.
    Clients in development always send `Authorization: Bearer dev` (the Prism mock rejects requests without it).
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
    description: local FastAPI
  - url: http://localhost:4010
    description: Prism mock
security:
  - bearerAuth: []

tags:
  - name: meta
  - name: profiles
  - name: analyses
  - name: quizzes
  - name: jobs
  - name: applications
  - name: cohorts

paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags: [meta]
      operationId: getHealth
      security: []
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [status, version]
                properties:
                  status: { type: string, enum: [ok] }
                  version: { type: string }
                  llm_provider: { type: string, examples: [gemini] }

  /v1/roles:
    get:
      tags: [meta]
      operationId: listRoles
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: Role catalogue
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Role" } }

  /v1/me:
    get:
      tags: [profiles]
      operationId: getMe
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: Current user's profile (demo profile when DEV_AUTH=1)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Profile" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }

  /v1/profiles:
    post:
      tags: [profiles]
      operationId: createProfile
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ProfileCreate" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Profile" }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError" }

  /v1/profiles/{profile_id}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/ProfileId" }]
    get:
      tags: [profiles]
      operationId: getProfile
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Profile" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
    patch:
      tags: [profiles]
      operationId: updateProfile
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ProfileUpdate" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Profile" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
    delete:
      tags: [profiles]
      operationId: deleteProfile
      description: Deletes the profile and all its documents, analyses and applications ("delete my data").
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "204": { description: Deleted }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }

  /v1/profiles/{profile_id}/documents:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/ProfileId" }]
    post:
      tags: [profiles]
      operationId: uploadDocument
      description: Upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) or LinkedIn profile PDF export. Max 5 MB.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [kind, file]
              properties:
                kind: { type: string, enum: [resume, linkedin] }
                file: { type: string, format: binary }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: Stored and text-extracted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Profile" }
        "413": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError" }

  /v1/profiles/{profile_id}/analyses:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/ProfileId" }]
    post:
      tags: [analyses]
      operationId: startAnalysis
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [role_id]
              properties:
                role_id: { type: string, examples: [sde-backend] }
                force_refresh: { type: boolean, default: false, description: Bypass cache }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "202":
          description: Accepted; poll GET /v1/analyses/{analysis_id}
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AnalysisStatus" }
        "409":
          description: Profile has no resume yet
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    get:
      tags: [analyses]
      operationId: listAnalyses
      description: History, newest first (for progress-over-time chart)
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AnalysisSummary" } }

  /v1/analyses/{analysis_id}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/AnalysisId" }]
    get:
      tags: [analyses]
      operationId: getAnalysis
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: Status, plus report when status=done
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Analysis" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }

  /v1/analyses/{analysis_id}/simulate:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/AnalysisId" }]
    post:
      tags: [analyses]
      operationId: simulateAnalysis
      description: What-if recomputation. Deterministic, no LLM or GitHub calls.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SimulationRequest" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SimulationResult" }

  /v1/analyses/{analysis_id}/roadmap/{milestone_id}:
    parameters:
      - { $ref: "#/components/parameters/AnalysisId" }
      - { name: milestone_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
    patch:
      tags: [analyses]
      operationId: updateMilestone
      description: Tick a roadmap milestone. Does not change the score; a re-scan does.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [done]
              properties:
                done: { type: boolean }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/RoadmapMilestone" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }

  /v1/analyses/{analysis_id}/quizzes:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/AnalysisId" }]
    post:
      tags: [quizzes]
      operationId: createQuiz
      description: |
        Generate a Project Understanding Check from the student's own repository (docs/QUIZ.md).
        Answer keys are never returned here. Takes ~10-20 s (one LLM call).
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizCreate" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Quiz" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
        "429":
          description: Verify cooldown active (details.retake_available_at) or LLM quota exhausted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }

  /v1/quizzes/{quiz_id}:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/QuizId" }]
    get:
      tags: [quizzes]
      operationId: getQuiz
      description: Resume a quiz. In verify mode returns only answered questions plus the current one, and records served_at for it.
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Quiz" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }

  /v1/quizzes/{quiz_id}/answers:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/QuizId" }]
    post:
      tags: [quizzes]
      operationId: answerQuizQuestion
      description: Practice mode returns graded feedback immediately. Verify mode only records the answer.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizAnswer" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizAnswerFeedback" }
        "409":
          description: Question already answered, out of order, or quiz already submitted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }

  /v1/quizzes/{quiz_id}/submit:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/QuizId" }]
    post:
      tags: [quizzes]
      operationId: submitQuiz
      description: Grades remaining answers, sets the project's understanding (verify mode) and re-runs scoring.
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizResult" }
        "409":
          description: Already submitted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }

  /v1/quizzes/{quiz_id}/result:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/QuizId" }]
    get:
      tags: [quizzes]
      operationId: getQuizResult
      description: Result of a submitted (or auto-submitted) quiz. Same body as submit returned.
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizResult" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
        "409":
          description: Quiz not submitted yet
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }

  /v1/profiles/{profile_id}/quizzes:
    parameters: [{ $ref: "#/components/parameters/ProfileId" }]
    get:
      tags: [quizzes]
      operationId: listQuizzes
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: Newest first
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizSummary" } }

  /v1/jobs/match:
    post:
      tags: [jobs]
      operationId: matchJob
      description: Used by the extension side panel. Returns keyword match AND evidence-backed match.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [profile_id, posting]
              properties:
                profile_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                posting: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/JobPosting" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/JobMatch" }
        "409":
          description: Profile has no completed analysis
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }

  /v1/applications:
    get:
      tags: [applications]
      operationId: listApplications
      parameters:
        - { name: profile_id, in: query, required: true, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Application" } }
    post:
      tags: [applications]
      operationId: createApplication
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApplicationCreate" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Application" }

  /v1/applications/{application_id}:
    parameters:
      - { name: application_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }
    patch:
      tags: [applications]
      operationId: updateApplication
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApplicationUpdate" }
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Application" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
    delete:
      tags: [applications]
      operationId: deleteApplication
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "204": { description: Deleted }

  /v1/applications/{application_id}/tailored-resume:
    parameters:
      - { name: application_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }
    post:
      tags: [applications]
      operationId: tailorResume
      description: P2. Rewrites using verified facts only.
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TailoredResume" }

  /v1/cohorts:
    get:
      tags: [cohorts]
      operationId: listCohorts
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Cohort" } }

  /v1/cohorts/{cohort_id}/insights:
    parameters:
      - { $ref: "#/components/parameters/CohortId" }
      - { name: role_id, in: query, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
    get:
      tags: [cohorts]
      operationId: getCohortInsights
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/CohortInsights" }

  /v1/cohorts/{cohort_id}/students:
    parameters:
      - { $ref: "#/components/parameters/CohortId" }
      - { name: role_id, in: query, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      - { name: at_risk_only, in: query, schema: { type: boolean, default: false } }
    get:
      tags: [cohorts]
      operationId: listCohortStudents
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/CohortStudent" } }

  /v1/cohorts/{cohort_id}/export:
    parameters:
      - { $ref: "#/components/parameters/CohortId" }
      - { name: role_id, in: query, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
    get:
      tags: [cohorts]
      operationId: exportCohort
      responses:
        default: { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "200":
          description: CSV file
          content:
            text/csv:
              schema: { type: string }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth: { type: http, scheme: bearer, bearerFormat: JWT }

  parameters:
    ProfileId: { name: profile_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }
    AnalysisId: { name: analysis_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }
    CohortId: { name: cohort_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }
    QuizId: { name: quiz_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string, format: uuid } }

  responses:
    NotFound:
      description: Not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    ValidationError:
      description: Invalid input
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    Error:
      description: Error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }

  schemas:
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code: { type: string, examples: [not_found, rate_limited, no_resume] }
        message: { type: string }
        details: { type: [object, "null"] }

    # ---------- catalogue ----------
    Role:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, category, skills]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, examples: [sde-backend] }
        name: { type: string, examples: [Backend Developer] }
        category: { type: string, enum: [engineering, data, design, product] }
        skills:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [skill_id, skill_name, importance]
            properties:
              skill_id: { type: string }
              skill_name: { type: string }
              importance: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 3 }
      examples:
        - id: sde-backend
          name: Backend Developer
          category: engineering
          skills:
            - { skill_id: python, skill_name: Python, importance: 3 }
            - { skill_id: sql, skill_name: SQL, importance: 3 }
            - { skill_id: fastapi, skill_name: FastAPI, importance: 2 }
            - { skill_id: docker, skill_name: Docker, importance: 2 }
            - { skill_id: ci-cd, skill_name: CI/CD, importance: 2 }
            - { skill_id: redis, skill_name: Redis, importance: 2 }
            - { skill_id: aws, skill_name: AWS, importance: 2 }
            - { skill_id: kubernetes, skill_name: Kubernetes, importance: 1 }

    Resource:
      type: object
      required: [id, title, url, type, skill_id]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        url: { type: string, format: uri }
        type: { type: string, enum: [course, documentation, video, practice, project_idea] }
        skill_id: { type: string }
        hours: { type: [integer, "null"] }

    # ---------- profiles ----------
    ProfileCreate:
      type: object
      required: [name]
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        email: { type: [string, "null"], format: email }
        github_username: { type: [string, "null"] }
        portfolio_urls: { type: array, items: { type: string, format: uri }, default: [] }
        linkedin_text: { type: [string, "null"], description: Pasted LinkedIn profile text (alternative to PDF export) }
        target_role_id: { type: [string, "null"] }
        department: { type: [string, "null"] }
        cohort_id: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }

    ProfileUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        github_username: { type: [string, "null"] }
        portfolio_urls: { type: array, items: { type: string, format: uri } }
        linkedin_text: { type: [string, "null"] }
        target_role_id: { type: [string, "null"] }
        department: { type: [string, "null"] }
        cohort_id: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }

    Profile:
      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ProfileCreate"
        - type: object
          required: [id, has_resume, has_linkedin, created_at]
          properties:
            id: { type: string, format: uuid }
            has_resume: { type: boolean }
            has_linkedin: { type: boolean }
            latest_analysis_id: { type: [string, "null"], format: uuid }
            latest_score: { type: [number, "null"] }
            created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      examples:
        - id: 3f2b8c1e-5d47-4a9b-8e21-7c6a0f9d1b34
          name: Demo Student
          email: null
          github_username: careerlens-demo
          portfolio_urls: []
          linkedin_text: null
          target_role_id: sde-backend
          department: CSE
          cohort_id: 6b1f4c2a-9d3e-4f7a-8c55-2e0a7d9b1c44
          has_resume: true
          has_linkedin: true
          latest_analysis_id: 9a7d2e40-1c3b-4f58-b6a9-0d5e8c2f7a11
          latest_score: 65.1
          created_at: "2026-10-01T09:30:00Z"

    # ---------- analyses ----------
    AnalysisStage:
      type: string
      enum: [queued, ingesting, extracting, collecting, detecting, judging, scoring, planning, done, failed]

    AnalysisStatus:
      type: object
      required: [id, profile_id, role_id, status, progress, created_at]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        profile_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        role_id: { type: string }
        status: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AnalysisStage" }
        progress: { type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 100 }
        error: { type: [string, "null"] }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        finished_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      examples:
        - id: 9a7d2e40-1c3b-4f58-b6a9-0d5e8c2f7a11
          profile_id: 3f2b8c1e-5d47-4a9b-8e21-7c6a0f9d1b34
          role_id: sde-backend
          status: done
          progress: 100
          error: null
          created_at: "2026-10-07T10:15:00Z"
          finished_at: "2026-10-07T10:15:48Z"

    AnalysisSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, role_id, status, created_at]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        role_id: { type: string }
        status: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AnalysisStage" }
        score: { type: [number, "null"] }
        coverage: { type: [number, "null"] }
        verified_skills: { type: [integer, "null"], description: Claimed skills at strong or moderate }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      examples:
        - id: 9a7d2e40-1c3b-4f58-b6a9-0d5e8c2f7a11
          role_id: sde-backend
          status: done
          score: 65.1
          coverage: 62.5
          verified_skills: 5
          created_at: "2026-10-07T10:15:00Z"

    Analysis:
      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/AnalysisStatus"
        - type: object
          properties:
            report:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/AnalysisReport"
                - type: "null"

    Band: { type: string, enum: [not_ready, developing, ready] }
    Confidence: { type: string, enum: [low, medium, high] }
    EvidenceLevel: { type: string, enum: [strong, moderate, weak, unverified, missing] }

    AnalysisReport:
      type: object
      required: [score, coverage, claims, gaps, projects, role_fits, roadmap, evidence, notes]
      properties:
        score: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ScoreBreakdown" }
        coverage:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
          description: "% of claimed skills with strong or moderate evidence"
        claims: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SkillClaim" } }
        gaps: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SkillGap" } }

    ScoreBreakdown:
      type: object
      required: [total, band, confidence, components]
      properties:
        total: { type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 100 }
        band: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Band" }
        confidence: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Confidence" }
        capped: { type: boolean, default: false }
        components:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ScoreComponent" }
      examples: [*ex_score]

    ScoreComponent:
      type: object
      required: [key, label, weight, score, contribution, reasons]
      properties:
        key: { type: string, enum: [skill_evidence, project_quality, consistency, experience, resume_quality] }
        label: { type: string }
        weight: { type: number, description: Effective weight after reweighting }
        score: { type: [number, "null"], description: "0-100, null when no data" }
        contribution: { type: number, description: weight × score }
        reasons:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [text, delta]
            properties:
              text: { type: string, examples: ["Docker verified in repo 'campus-api' (11 authored commits)"] }
              delta: { type: number, description: Points gained (+) or withheld (-) inside this component }
              evidence_ids: { type: array, items: { type: string } }

    Evidence:
      type: object
      required: [id, kind, source, label]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        kind: { type: string, enum: [repo, file, commit_range, portfolio_item, experience, resume_text, linkedin, certificate] }
        source: { type: string, enum: [github, resume, linkedin, portfolio] }
        label: { type: string }
        url: { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }
        details: { type: [object, "null"] }

    SkillClaim:
      type: object
      required: [skill_id, skill_name, claimed, level, reason, evidence_ids]
      properties:
        skill_id: { type: string }
        skill_name: { type: string }
        claimed: { type: boolean }
        level: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/EvidenceLevel" }
        reason: { type: string }
        evidence_ids: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      examples: [*ex_claim]

    SkillGap:

        skill_name: { type: string }
        importance: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 3 }
        claimed: { type: boolean, description: "true = on the resume but under-evidenced; false = not claimed" }
        level: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/EvidenceLevel" }
        estimated_gain: { type: number }

        reason: { type: string }

        text: { type: [string, "null"], description: "Short answer, max 2000 chars" }
        time_taken_ms: { type: integer }
        focus_lost_count: { type: integer, default: 0 }

    KeyPointResult:
      type: object
      required: [text, status]
      properties:
        text: { type: string }
        status: { type: string, enum: [covered, partial, missing] }

    QuizAnswerFeedback:
      type: object
      required: [question_id, recorded]
      description: |
        Verify mode before submit: only question_id, recorded and timed_out are set; every grading and
        answer-key field is null or empty. Practice mode and QuizResult.per_question: all fields set.
      properties:
        question_id: { type: string }
        recorded: { type: boolean }
        timed_out: { type: boolean, default: false }
        choice_id: { type: [string, "null"], description: The student's own MCQ answer }
        text: { type: [string, "null"], description: The student's own short answer }
        score: { type: [number, "null"], description: "0-1; null in verify mode until submitted" }
        correct_choice_id: { type: [string, "null"] }
        key_points: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/KeyPointResult" } }
        incorrect_statements: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        feedback: { type: [string, "null"] }
        model_answer: { type: [string, "null"] }
        source_ref:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/SourceRef"
            - type: "null"

    QuizResult:
      type: object
      required: [quiz_id, mode, score, understanding, per_question, review_topics, strengths]
      properties:
        quiz_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        mode: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizMode" }
        score: { type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 100 }
        understanding:
          description: Set in verify mode only; null for practice (practice never changes evidence)
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Understanding"
            - type: "null"
        per_question: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizAnswerFeedback" } }
        strengths: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        review_topics:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [topic]
            properties:
              topic: { type: string }
              source_ref:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/SourceRef"
                  - type: "null"
        focus_lost_total: { type: integer, description: Shown to the student only }
        flag:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ProjectFlag"
            - type: "null"
        score_update:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/SimulationResult"
            - type: "null"
        retake_available_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }

    QuizSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, project_id, project_title, mode, status, created_at]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        project_id: { type: string }
        project_title: { type: string }
        mode: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizMode" }
        status: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuizStatus" }
        score: { type: [number, "null"] }
        understanding:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Understanding"
            - type: "null"
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }

    # ---------- jobs & applications ----------
    JobPosting:
      type: object
      required: [title, description, source]
      properties:
        title: { type: string }
        company: { type: [string, "null"] }
        location: { type: [string, "null"] }
        url: { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }
        description: { type: string, description: "Plain text, max 20k chars" }
        required_skills: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        nice_to_have: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        deadline: { type: [string, "null"], format: date }
        source: { type: string, enum: [jsonld, dom, llm, manual] }

    JobMatch:
      type: object
      required: [keyword_match, evidence_match, matched, missing, unverified, summary]
      properties:
        keyword_match: { type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 100 }
        evidence_match: { type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 100 }
        matched:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [skill_id, skill_name, level]
            properties:
              skill_id: { type: string }
              skill_name: { type: string }
              level: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/EvidenceLevel" }
        missing: { type: array, items: { type: string }, description: Skill display names required by the posting with no claim or evidence }
        unverified: { type: array, items: { type: string }, description: Skill display names claimed at weak or unverified }
        summary: { type: string }
        normalized_posting: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/JobPosting" }
      examples:
        - keyword_match: 85.7
          evidence_match: 60
          matched:
            - { skill_id: python, skill_name: Python, level: strong }
            - { skill_id: fastapi, skill_name: FastAPI, level: strong }
            - { skill_id: sql, skill_name: SQL, level: strong }
            - { skill_id: docker, skill_name: Docker, level: strong }
            - { skill_id: kubernetes, skill_name: Kubernetes, level: unverified }
            - { skill_id: aws, skill_name: AWS, level: unverified }
          missing: [Redis]
          unverified: [Kubernetes, AWS]
          summary: "You mention 6 of the 7 required skills and 4 are backed by your own repositories. Kubernetes and AWS are claimed without evidence yet; Redis is not on your profile."
          normalized_posting:
            title: Backend Engineer Intern
            company: Northwind Labs
            location: Chennai, India
            url: null
            description: "We are looking for a backend intern to build and maintain REST APIs in Python (FastAPI) on PostgreSQL, packaged with Docker and deployed to Kubernetes on AWS. Experience with Redis caching is required."
            required_skills: [Python, FastAPI, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Redis]
            nice_to_have: []
            deadline: null
            source: jsonld

    ApplicationStatus: { type: string, enum: [saved, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected] }

    ApplicationCreate:
      type: object
      required: [profile_id, company, title]
      properties:
        profile_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        company: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        url: { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }
        status: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApplicationStatus" }
        deadline: { type: [string, "null"], format: date }
        keyword_match: { type: [number, "null"] }
        evidence_match: { type: [number, "null"] }
        description: { type: [string, "null"] }
        notes: { type: [string, "null"] }

    ApplicationUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        status: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApplicationStatus" }
        deadline: { type: [string, "null"], format: date }
        notes: { type: [string, "null"] }
        applied_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }

    Application:
      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApplicationCreate"
        - type: object
          required: [id, status, created_at, updated_at]
          properties:
            id: { type: string, format: uuid }
            applied_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
            created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
            updated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }

    TailoredResume:
      type: object
      required: [bullets, numbers_without_evidence, skills_order]
      properties:
        bullets:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [original, rewritten]
            properties:
              original: { type: string }

        numbers_without_evidence: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        skills_order: { type: array, items: { type: string } }

    Cohort:
